sn56.40:1.1: yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe…
sn56.40:1.2: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vādatthiko vādagavesī
sn56.40:1.3: vādamassa āropessāmīti. taṃ vata sahadhammena saṅkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

sn56.40:1.7: vādamassa āropessāmīti. taṃ vata sahadhammena saṅkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn56.40:2.3: puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya pacchimāya cepi disāya. uttarāya cepi disāya. dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya.

sn56.40:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
